notes: 0.2.0-experimental moves the pin from the octabam wrapper (sambanks/octabam b725fb1a, author pin 329b801c) to the author's repository at 109f54c: DIRECT JUMP V7.2.2. upstream/OCTABAM_README.md and upstream/OCTABAM_LICENSE stay as imported from octabam for its integration credit.
patch_directjump_v7.s comments describe stock routines and data by address and in assembler mnemonics, as the author wrote them; it contains no firmware bytes or hex dumps.

The stock guard digests were computed from the author's declared expectations and matched against a local original OS 1.40C MAIN image (SHA-256 164f31224bf61181e3f50e7dec40df9afcae5b16dbf6e4c0d0cc5e986af0a84e).

transforms: The author's V7.2.2 with six re-encodings, each marked MODWERK, so that no 12 bytes of the USB package repeat stock code (the strict stock-free scan): the four inline kernel posts ({0x11, pattern} in dj_unhide and the landing, {0x15, bank} and {0x14, part}) go through one added helper, dj_post, which reaches KPOST through %a1 (the same calls with the same arguments in the same order, every caller inside dj_land, which saves every register); the second purge table's two addresses are loaded in the other order (a3 before a1); and the hand-off's switch time is formed as TICK_A + SCLK instead of SCLK + TICK_A (move.l #imm then add.l: the same sum, register and flags). The unit shrinks from 3,846 to 3,826 bytes; with these changes taken back it links to the author's bytes (SHA-256 688978daa1ed86c0a0874404e859ee781fbfbed7808be33c2f862beb3e373011 at 0x400d6d38, his manifest's REFERENCE).

Rewrite the declaration for Modwerk: the same DRAM unit, four detours (the landing, the MIDI START gate, the [PTN] release and V7.2's light Part apply LFO AUTO CHANGE test at 0x40009ebe) and symbol reference, with every stock expectation an address/length/SHA-256 guard in place of the stock bytes the author's file spells out.

Drop requires=("BATCH_BUGFIXES",): Modwerk modules never depend on another module. The bundle was required for its MIDI_PLAYS_FREE_FIX, which this module has carried since 0.1.1-experimental as a second DRAM unit (patch_trigscale.s) and one more detour, guarded over the 18 stock bytes it redoes.

Drop the two Keeps around the [PTN]-layer YES record (a USB package cannot carry them; the symbol reference's NULL guard still refuses a changed slot) and the conflicts with octabam's DIRECT JUMP and OCTAKIT, which Modwerk does not have.
Add the author fields, UNIT_BYTES and Modwerk's references for the re-encoded units.
